preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n, where 2 ≤ n ≤ 100,000.
Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty string consisting of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all input strings is at most 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the beauty of the product string, where beauty is defined as the length of the longest substring consisting of only one letter.

The output integer is the beauty of the string obtained by sequentially multiplying the input strings p1, p2, ..., pn using Denis's multiplication rule: ((((p1 * p2) * p3) * ...) * pn), where s * t = t + s[0] + t + s[1] + ... + t + s[-1] + t, and beauty is defined as the length of the longest substring consisting of only one letter.
